| # Password guideline {#password-guideline-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                               |                                                                                                                                          |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The authentication procedure used to secure the RC is only effective if you chose a strong password and make sure that only trusted personnel know it. The following section provides a list of best practices to keep your passwords secure.

## Password format {#password-format .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

+-----------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ID                    | Practice                                                                   | Description                                                                                              |
+=======================+============================================================================+==========================================================================================================+
| 1                     | Choose a strong password                                                   | •Use upper- and lowercase letters (A-Z, a-z).                                                            |
|                       |                                                                            |                                                                                                          |
|                       |                                                                            | •Use numbers and special characters (1-9, !#?\...).                                                      |
+-----------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| #PF2                  | Avoid common or easy to guess passwords                                    | •Common passwords are vulnerable against brute-force attacks.                                            |
|                       |                                                                            |                                                                                                          |
|                       |                                                                            | •The same applies to passwords like \"1111\".                                                            |
+-----------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| #PF3                  | Avoid passwords that can be guessed based on another access-level password | •Do not choose access level passwords like \"Password1\" and \"Password2\" for succeeding access levels. |
|                       |                                                                            |                                                                                                          |
|                       |                                                                            | •Make sure that there is no correlation between each access level password.                              |
+-----------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| #PF4                  | Do not use short or padded passwords                                       | •Define passwords of at least 16 characters.                                                             |
|                       |                                                                            |                                                                                                          |
|                       |                                                                            | •Do not use repeated characters or any other padding.                                                    |
+-----------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

 

## Password storage {#password-storage .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

+-----------------------+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ID                    | Practice                             | Description                                                                                            |
+=======================+======================================+========================================================================================================+
| #PS1                  | Follow the Need-to-know priciple     | •Make sure that passwords are known only by persons that require access to restricted RC functions.    |
|                       |                                      |                                                                                                        |
|                       |                                      | •Use the access level concept and limit the permissions of users to features that they require.        |
+-----------------------+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| #PS2                  | Store passwords in a secure location | •Do not store passwords in plain text on your computer or on a hand-written note next to you computer. |
+-----------------------+--------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

 

## Password policy {#password-policy .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

+-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ID                    | Practice                                                | Description                                                                                                                                                 |
+=======================+=========================================================+=============================================================================================================================================================+
| #PP1                  | Do not use default passwords                            | •The default access level passwords of our RCs are not confidential and widely known.                                                                       |
|                       |                                                         |                                                                                                                                                             |
|                       |                                                         | •Series RCs must not use the default access level passwords with which they are delivered.                                                                  |
|                       |                                                         |                                                                                                                                                             |
|                       |                                                         | •You can order RCs with a customized set of access level passwords such that you do not have to change the passwords yourself.                              |
+-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| #PP2                  | Change passwords only in a secure environment           | •Passwords are transferred to the ECU in an unencrypted fashion when changing them. This is the only time in which passwords are transferred in clear text. |
|                       |                                                         |                                                                                                                                                             |
|                       |                                                         | •You have to rule out any other connected device logs the transferred data while changing the passwords.                                                    |
+-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| #PP3                  | Choose different passwords for different devices        | •Prevents one leaked password to compromise the security of all RCs.                                                                                        |
+-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| #PP4                  | Have different passwords for development and series RCs | •Passwords of RCs that are only used for development or testing should be different from RCs that are used productively.                                    |
+-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

 

## Vulnerability monitoring {#vulnerability-monitoring .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

+-----------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ID                    | Practice                                 | Description                                                                                  |
+=======================+==========================================+==============================================================================================+
| #VM1                  | React to claims of compromised passwords | •Look out for third-parties that could have compromised the security of your devices.        |
|                       |                                          |                                                                                              |
|                       |                                          | •Change the password of your RCs immediately if you think they are not confidential anymore. |
+-----------------------+------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
